briefdescription.para: Common QML item contract for data series hosted by PlotView.

detaileddescription.para: PlotSeries owns the integration shared by every plot type: axis bindings, plot-area layout, data-range reporting, legend metadata, and a common C++ data-setting API backed by the series' data points. Concrete series define their data point layout, rendering, and hit testing.
setData(), setDataF(), and postData() take interleaved values, one data point after another, in the layout of the series:

The buffer holds count times that many values. A HeatmapSeries takes its cells row by row, columns per row. Series-specific setters take other layouts, such as point values, categories, or ranged bars.
Series smooth their edges with the inherited antialiasing property. HeatmapSeries ignores it.
